papers.reason: The atlas records FibA as another name for Fib_A, so this is the study the cell set is named after even though it contributed the fewer cells.

questions.ask: What does this study mean by FibA, and does it describe the cells the atlas placed under that name?

papers.reason: Largest contributor, but under a single coarse label covering both cell sets. One read should establish that it does not separate them.

atlas_only.reason: The atlas records no contributing study for these cells.
